description: The zero, successor, and nonzero-limit supremum equations determine ordinal multiplication uniquely.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.OrdinalArithmetic.multiplication_recursion_unique.{u_1}
  (f : Ordinal.{u_1} → Ordinal.{u_1} → Ordinal.{u_1}) (hz : ∀ (a : Ordinal.{u_1}), f a 0 = 0)
  (hs : ∀ (a b : Ordinal.{u_1}), f a (b + 1) = f a b + a)
  (hl : ∀ (a l : Ordinal.{u_1}), Order.IsSuccLimit l → f a l = ⨆ b, f a ↑b) : f = fun x1 x2 => x1 * x2
